resources.string: Stream screen and audio directly from your Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac) to this TV via AirPlay.
When enabled, the service starts on TV boot and listens in the background. When disabled, it runs only while the app is active.
Foreground Daemon Service + On-Demand Jetpack Compose for TV Interface.
Apple AirPlay Mirroring (RTSP 7000), mDNS/DNS-SD (_airplay._tcp, _raop._tcp), MediaCodec AVC H.264 Hardware Decoder, Low-Latency PCM AudioTrack.
